request.query: Which drugs frequently co-occur in combination studies for melanoma (drug ↔ drug network)?

visualization.title: Drug / intervention co-occurrence network for melanoma
visualization.subtitle: I interpreted this as a request for a drug–drug co-occurrence network among interventions in clinical trials for melanoma, to identify which drugs are most frequently combined in the same study.

plan.interpretation: I interpreted this as a request for a drug–drug co-occurrence network among interventions in clinical trials for melanoma, to identify which drugs are most frequently combined in the same study.

notes: Node weight = trials mentioning the entity; edge weight = trials in which both entities appear together. Placebo-like arms are excluded.
warnings: Cohort 'Melanoma combination studies': 3771 studies match but only the first 1000 were analysed (max_trials). Raise max_trials for complete coverage.
